import json,re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMCOR_2023_10K_reconstructed.json'
obj=json.load(open(p))['texts']
patterns=['Employer Identification Number','IRS','incorporation or organization','incorporated','Delaware']
for pat in patterns:
    print('PATTERN',pat)
    for i,t in enumerate(obj):
        text=t.get('text','')+' '+t.get('text_span','')
        if pat.lower() in text.lower():
            print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',text[:200])
            break
